description: Committed fixture for the blind bank audition (vocal-mcp-control-and-quality.md §12 slice 6, D30) and the Whisper intelligibility check (scripts/vocal-intelligibility.py). Two plain lines at 120 bpm, every multi-syllable word split with `·` so syllables == notes: 16 syllables + one `_` melisma on 'sing' = 17 notes, an `AP` breath in the half-beat rest between the lines. `pitch` is written in C (tonic C4 = 60, span C4..C5, one octave); the test transposes the whole melody per bank x speaker so its duration-weighted centre sits in the middle of that voice's comfortable range (`BankProfile::comfortable_range`). `text` is what an intelligible render should be heard as.
lines: Walk with me a·long the riv·er
AP we will sing _ un·til the morn·ing
text: walk with me along the river we will sing until the morning
